name: plan-review-verdict
body: The plan-review agent's verdict on a plan against the change-set delta, in two passes. (a) A DETERMINISTIC coverage verdict read from the binary's `apg plan verify` refusal: the `domain.entity.plan-coverage` rule decides which solution nodes' `implemented-by` claims are in scope; the per-FQN entries under the refusal's `coverage incomplete:` clause are the blocking gaps, each attached to the owning phase/task; the `no implemented-by edge` (no-claims) list in that same clause is informational; the absence of a `coverage incomplete:` clause means coverage holds. The unrealized-planned-node and unresolved-feedback barriers and a stale branch graph lie outside the coverage verdict; the agent ensures the branch scan is fresh first and reads the binary's coverage verdict from the refusal. (b) A SEMANTIC verdict on each plan node: whether it does the right thing for the delta, ranking `deletes` over `modifies` over `creates`; a removed solution node or `implemented-by` edge pairs with a `deletes` task over the code it pointed at, and a keep-or-modify alternative carries a task-note justification.
